connector.name: ARES (Czech business registry)
connector.registryDescription: MCP for ARES, the Czech business registry: lookup, due diligence, insolvency, signed provenance
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package ares-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the milos106 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: ARES_PROVENANCE_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Optional Ed25519 private key (base64 PKCS#8 DER) to enable signed provenance envelopes. Omit to run unsigned.

env.name: ARES_PROVENANCE_KEY_ID
env.description: Optional key id advertised in signed envelopes and the JWKS. Defaults to a thumbprint of the public key.

env.name: ARES_BASE_URL
env.description: Optional override of the ARES REST base URL (defaults to the public ares.gov.cz endpoint).
